name: Pinecrest Holiday Parks
description: Operator of 3 caravan and lodge parks in the fictional Greywater National Park.

items.title: Published drowning inquest findings
items.content: A public inquest concluded on 2026-04-27 that a 9-year-old guest drowned in the Lakeside park pool in 2025 because no lifeguard was on duty; Pinecrest now staffs the pool from 08:50 to 19:10. Record PHP-INQ-0427.

items.title: Pet policy
items.content: Up to 2 dogs are allowed in pet-friendly lodges at $16.50 per dog per night. Policy PHP-PET-2.

items.title: Maintenance call-out rota
items.content: Out-of-hours call-outs go to Sion Pritchard on 0771 902 3384 for Lakeside and to Beth Garroway for Hilltop. Rota PHP-MNT-33.

items.title: Lodge changeover times
items.content: Cleaners have 3 hours 40 minutes per lodge on Fridays; linen arrives at the depot by 09:05. Plan PHP-CHG-340.

items.title: Lodge owner fee dispute
items.content: 41 lodge owners refuse to pay a 19.5% rise in site fees; Pinecrest plans to end the agreements of the 6 group leaders from 2027-03-01. File PHP-BUG-1031.

items.title: Planning dispute over new lodges
items.content: Pinecrest built 18 lodges at Hilltop without full planning permission; the park authority could order demolition, and legal advice puts the risk at $1.75M. File PHP-PLN-7718-H.
